ownerStatement: I'll waive chip-worst-case-cycles and current-build-hardware for this version on your MKII figures and write the approval record myself, so no flood comparison first. (https://github.com/repeat98/modwerk/pull/1258#issuecomment-6683679161)
reason: Card-only first release. The frame hook was timed on the author's MKII on image STEMMW1 (53 us at most over two eleven-file 24-bit takes, 13,992 of 95,782 cycles a block); there is no static bound because its cost is mostly uncached ring stores and cache misses. No cfmeter benchmark or flood was run: Stem Rec has no MIDI path. The exact library build has not run on a unit, and hardware is not claimed verified. Limits are in TESTING.md and compatibility.limitations.
